title: Encino Man
tagline: Thawed out caveman. Ready to eat.

    StartersLink's ice block cheddar cheese ballCheddar and cream cheese ball with jalapeño, rolled in bacon and pretzel crumbsHow to make it250g cream cheese, softened200g sharp cheddar, grated2 tbsp pickled jalapenos, chopped1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp Worcestershire sauce4 rashers of bacon60g pretzels, crushed1 tbsp chives, snippedcrushed ice, to serve1 packet of crackersBeat the cream cheese, cheddar, jalapeno, paprika and Worcestershire sauce.Shape into a ball, wrap and chill.Fry the bacon until crisp and crumble with the pretzels and chives.Roll the ball in the crumb.Serve on a plate of crushed ice with crackers.Estonian exchange student drumsticksSmoky paprika drumsticks roasted until sticky with barbecue sauceHow to make it1kg chicken drumsticks2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder2 tbsp brown sugar4 tbsp barbecue sauceHeat the oven to 220°C. Rub the drumsticks with the paprika, garlic powder and sugar.Roast the drumsticks.Brush with barbecue sauce and roast until sticky.Dave's backyard loaded nachosThe backyard where they dig the poolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Corn chips baked under black beans, chorizo and two cheeses, piled with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of lime.Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp.Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the chorizo, 1 drained tin black beans, 150g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, and bake at 200°C for 8 minutes.Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt.Top the nachos with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeños, coriander and lime wedges.Buttered corn on the cobCorn Nuts, the vegetable group, says Stoney.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPool party teriyaki chickenTeriyaki chicken thigh skewers, grilled and basted, with steamed riceHow to make it1kg chicken thigh, diced125ml teriyaki sauce1 tbsp ginger, grated2 cloves of garlic, crushed12 skewers300g jasmine rice1 tbsp sesame seedsToss the chicken in the teriyaki sauce, ginger and garlic.Marinate.Thread onto skewers.Grill, turning and basting.Steam the rice.Serve with sesame seeds.Link's caveman beef short ribsMeat group! A big hunk of beef on the bone, eaten with both handsHow to make it1.6kg beef short ribs2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml beef stock150ml barbecue sauce300g shredded cabbage1 carrot, grated3 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tbsp apple cider vinegarHeat the oven to 160°C. Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.Put the ribs in a deep tray with the stock, cover tightly with foil and roast until tender.Brush with barbecue sauce and roast uncovered until sticky.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and vinegar and serve with the ribs.SweetsBlock of ice yoghurt barkHoney vanilla yoghurt frozen with berries and pistachios, broken into shardsHow to make it500g Greek yoghurt3 tbsp honey1 tsp vanilla extract150g mixed berries40g pistachios, crushedLine a tray with baking paper.Mix the yoghurt, honey and vanilla and spread thin.Scatter with berries and pistachios.Freeze until firm.Break into shards.DrinksLink's tropical mango smoothieStrawberry layered under a thick mango, banana, pineapple and orange smoothieHow to make it200g frozen strawberries1 tbsp honey2 mangoes, chopped2 bananas, frozen200g pineapple400ml orange juice1 handful of iceBlend the strawberries with the honey and spoon into the bottom of 4 tall glasses.Blend the mango, bananas, pineapple, orange juice and ice until thick.Pour slowly over the strawberry so it swirls up the sides.Serve with a straw.Grape juice spritzerWeasin' the juice, buddy.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
